settings.title: AI Data Training (Opt-Out Not Required)
settings.description: By default, Notion and its AI Subprocessors do not use Customer Data to train any models. Contractual agreements prohibit subprocessors from using customer data for model training. No opt-out toggle exists because training is not enabled by default. The optional AI LEAP Program allows customers to opt-in to share data for model improvement.
settings_path: N/A - disabled by default, no toggle required

verification_method.expected_text: By default, Notion and its AI Subprocessors do not use Customer Data to train any models

settings.title: Enable web search for workspace
settings.description: Controls whether Notion AI can search the web when answering questions. When enabled, AI queries may use external web data to supplement responses.

settings.title: Require confirmation for web requests
settings.description: Requires user approval before Notion AI accesses external websites. Adds an approval step before AI performs web-based lookups.

settings.title: 2-step verification
settings.description: Enables two-step verification for your Notion account. Supports authenticator apps and SMS text codes. Up to 4 verification methods (2 authenticators + 2 phone numbers). Generates 6 single-use backup codes on first setup. Note: workspace owners cannot enforce this for all users at this time.

settings.title: Passkeys
settings.description: Allows adding phishing-resistant passkeys for account authentication. Supports synced passkeys (OS credential managers, password managers) and device-bound passkeys (hardware security keys like YubiKey). Maximum 5 passkeys per account. Cannot be used if organization requires identity provider login.

settings.title: Manage connections
settings.description: Review and manage all third-party integrations connected to your workspace. Members and workspace owners can add connections; Enterprise workspace owners can restrict to pre-approved connections only. Connections must be added per-page after workspace installation.

settings.title: Manage page access for connections
settings.description: Controls who can connect/disconnect integrations from pages. Options: 'Default' (all workspace owners and members) or 'Workspace owners' only. Enterprise plan workspace owners can select specific pages a connection can access.

settings.title: Notion AI Connectors
settings.description: Manage third-party app connections for Notion AI (Slack, Google Drive, Jira, GitHub, etc.). Workspace owner status required. Content becomes unsearchable within 1 hour of disconnection, data deleted within 1 day. Notion does not use connector data to train models.
settings.recommended: connect only necessary apps, review regularly

settings.title: Disable publishing sites, forms and public links
settings.description: Prevents members from sharing pages via 'Share to web' option and publishing Notion Sites or forms. Disables all public sharing links workspace-wide.

settings.title: Disable guests
settings.description: Prevents anyone from inviting people outside the workspace to any page. Workspace owners can still enable guest invite requests for reviewed external access even when guests are disabled.

settings.title: Disable duplicating pages to other workspaces
settings.description: Prevents data from leaving the workspace via the Move to or Duplicate actions. Blocks members from moving or duplicating pages to external workspaces.

verification_method.expected_text: Disable duplicating pages to other workspaces

settings.title: Disable export
settings.description: Removes the Export button from the user interface, preventing members from exporting page and database content as PDF, HTML, Markdown or CSV.

settings.title: Allowed email domains
settings.description: Restricts automatic workspace membership to users with specified email domains. Users with matching email domains can join the workspace as members automatically.

settings.title: Profile discoverability
settings.description: Controls whether users can see your name and profile picture when inviting you to workspaces via your email address. When off, your profile is hidden from people who have your email address.

settings.title: Show my view history
settings.description: Controls whether your account activity appears in page analytics and view history. When set to 'Don't record', your views will not be tracked in page analytics.

settings.title: Support access
settings.description: Grants Notion support staff access to your account data for troubleshooting. Access is valid for 28 days or until revoked. Can be revoked at any time before the 28-day window expires.

settings.title: Enable SAML SSO
settings.description: Enables SAML Single Sign-On for the workspace, allowing users to authenticate via an identity provider (Okta, Microsoft Azure, Google Workspace, etc.).

settings.title: SCIM provisioning
settings.description: Enables System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) for automated user and group provisioning and deprovisioning.

settings.title: Verified domains
settings.description: Claim ownership over a domain to unlock advanced management settings including the ability to manage all users with that email domain.

settings.title: Audit log
settings.description: Provides detailed information about security and safety-related activity in the workspace. Supports filtering and export. Useful for identifying potential security issues, investigating suspicious behavior, and troubleshooting access.

settings.title: Allow page access requests from non-members
settings.description: Controls whether non-members can request access to workspace pages. When enabled, non-members who have a page link can request access.

verification_method.expected_text: Allow page access requests from non-members
